overview: Nuba, the Goddess of Drought, is a Warrior of the Club faction whose entire kit revolves around Crimson Doom Mark — a stacking debuff system that drains resources, reduces effectiveness, and punishes enemies for carrying her mark.

Unlike most Warriors who deal straightforward burst damage, Nuba layers multiple debuffs over time while simultaneously reducing enemy effectiveness and amplifying her own follow-up damage. Her passive resurrection mechanic via Rise of the Drought provides unexpected survivability in extended fights.

As a Club faction hero, Nuba scales strongly when fielded alongside other Club heroes — the faction bonus grants stacking ATK and HP to the whole team, reinforcing a protected backline scaling role rather than a primary tank role.

factionSynergy.label: Faction Bonus — Club
factionSynergy.intro: Fielding multiple Club faction heroes grants the entire team bonus ATK and HP. Thresholds:

items.label: 5 Club heroes:
items.text: +35% ATK & HP for the team — maximum bonus

factionSynergy.note: Nuba benefits from sustained HP (enabling her revive to matter more) and amplified ATK (making her Stun windows hit harder). Maximizing the Club faction count strengthens her kit.

coreMechanic.label: The Doom Mark System
bullets: Applied to the 3 farthest enemies at the start of battle passively via her Ultimate passive, and re-applied to the nearest enemy whenever the Ultimate activates.
Every 2.5s, Doom Mark deals DMG equal to 15% of current HP (capped at 240% ATK) and destroys 50 Energy — actively stalling enemy Ultimate cycles.
When a marked enemy falls, the mark does not disappear — it drains the target's essence and spawns a Source of the Drought Devil at the target's location.
Skill 1 (Infernal Soulbreaker) deals bonus damage and Stuns targets that carry the mark.
The Source of the Drought Devil is her revive token — consumed by Rise of the Drought to bring Nuba back to life at her current position.
Her Relic (Curse of Decay) makes marked enemies deal less DMG and permanently lose ATK SPD with each Ultimate cast — stacks up to 4 times.

skillNotes.ult: Dual-purpose: passive mark spread at battle start (3 farthest enemies) + active single-target mark, disable, and Energy drain. The active absorbs 200 Energy from the target — potentially resetting their Ultimate charge. Energy context: all heroes fill their Energy bar passively; Nuba's kit both destroys and absorbs it.
skillNotes.skill2: Primary CC tool. Requires a marked target to reach full potential — which is likely in most fights given the passive mark at battle start. The Stun duration increases to 3s at Lv3.
skillNotes.skill3: Passive lifesteal that converts overflow healing into a shield. At Lv4, Nuba heals for 100% of all damage dealt by herself AND the Doom Mark ticks — in sustained fights this creates near-permanent shielding.
skillNotes.skill4: Self-revive gated behind the Drought Devil sources generated by falling marked enemies. The HP restored scales with how long the source existed before use (Lv3). Requires skill investment to unlock at Lv1.
skillNotes.relic: ATK SPD reduction is permanent and stacks with every Ultimate cast (up to 4×). At Relic Lv2, Nuba herself gains 15% DMG RED per active Doom Mark — with 3 marks on the field, that's 45% personal damage reduction. Lv3 halves the Doom Mark tick interval from 2.5s to 1.5s.

skillUpgradePriority: 1. Siphon of Souls (Ultimate) — Core mechanic; Energy absorption scaling and active DMG increases are essential
2. Curse of Decay (Relic) — ATK SPD stacking is the primary debuff axis; Lv2 personal DMG RED is massive
3. Rite of Ashes — Lifesteal and shield ceiling increase with Lv upgrades; makes her self-sustaining
4. Rise of the Drought — Lv3 scales revive HP with source duration; Lv4 increases base restoration
5. Infernal Soulbreaker — Stun duration increase at Lv3 is useful; lower overall priority

ratingDescriptions.PVP: CC + ATK SPD drain = oppressive in long control fights
ratingDescriptions.PVE / Campaign: Solid debuffer; revive adds longevity; ATK SPD drain effective in prolonged campaign stages
ratingDescriptions.Boss Fights: Energy drain slows boss ults; Stun useful; single-target focus limits Doom Mark spread

paragraphs: Nuba is best protected in the backline as a scaling anchor rather than exposed early as a tank. Club faction pairing (e.g., Pan) complements her Energy denial loop, while a defensive support like Yuelao can add sustain to keep the control core online longer.

In longer fights, backline placement increases consistency of her ATK SPD stacking, Energy denial cadence, and reliable revive timing. If lacking dupe/relic investment she will give enemies free energy — protect her until she's properly invested.

strengths: Applies Crimson Doom Mark at battle start passively — no ramp-up required for debuffing
Permanent ATK SPD reduction on marked enemies stacks up to 4× — grows more oppressive as the fight extends
Built-in self-revive through Drought Devil sources provides exceptional staying power
Energy drain/destruction on Ultimate can delay and disrupt enemy Ultimate rotations
Reliable Stun on Skill 1 against marked targets — near-100% CC uptime against tagged enemies
Passive lifesteal + overflow shield (Rite of Ashes) makes her self-sustaining once invested
Dual debuff coverage: DMG reduction + ATK SPD reduction simultaneously
weaknesses: At low dupe/relic investment, Doom Mark passive ticks can actually feed enemy Energy instead of draining it
Self-revive requires sources to exist — if marks expire before she dies, no revive token is available
Single-target focus on Ultimate active — mark re-application hits only the nearest enemy
No direct healing outside of the revive HP restore — vulnerable to sustained burst before marks expire
Utility-focused — needs supporting DPS; does not function as a standalone damage carry

paragraphs: Club faction stacking is Nuba's most concrete synergy path. Running 3–5 Club heroes gives the whole team bonus ATK and HP — both stats support a protected scaling setup where Nuba remains in backline and ramps safely over time.
In the proposed structure, Nuba + Pan form the Energy control backbone: Nuba destroys and absorbs Energy while Pan adds additional denial and control timing.
Demeter serves as the protection and stun-layering frontline, while Caishen accelerates team Energy cycles and supports tempo. Yuelao rounds out the core through defensive stat sharing and sustain.

playstyle: Nuba fits a protected attrition control core style. She does not win by early collapse pressure, but by making enemies progressively less capable of fighting back as ATK SPD and Energy pressure compound over the course of a fight.

Backline safety improves consistency of three key outcomes: ATK SPD stacking uptime, Energy denial frequency, and reliable revival trigger timing. In that model, she is a scaling anchor enabled by frontline protection, not the primary tank absorbing the first burst cycle.

The most important player decision is ensuring she survives long enough to accumulate Doom Mark sources for her revive. Once she has a revive token banked and ATK SPD stacks building, long fights increasingly favor this structure: protect Nuba, cycle control and Energy denial, let inevitability build through layered debuffs.
